posts.name: Tantuvardhan
posts.cooked:
@sayan @21f3000759

In previous term I used SSH key of this format → roll_number@sc-oppe.study.iitm.ac.in to login.
This time I got mail to use SSH key of this format → roll_number@se2001-oppe-room-4.study.iitm.ac.in

The first one is working but not the second one.

Which SSH key should I use ??

posts.name: MAYANK BHARTI
posts.cooked: you have to use the second one . the first was of last term . create a new key using ssh-keygen and paste it on the website given in the mail '“the passwordless” to get the access for the second vm

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
You have to use roll_number@se2001-oppe-room-4.study.iitm.ac.in

And upload your ssh key to the room 4 website following this

On another topic
  1. Cannot login to VM - follow the below
   cd .ssh
   ls 
   #check either of the two must be present id_ed25519.pub or id_rsa.pub
   cat id_ed25519.pub 
   #or 
   cat id_rsa.pub
   #copy the key and paste it to your vm
   #check above point if you don't know your vm

Use this to find your ssh portal to submit the public key
